title: A 30-mile perfectly straight edge on Mars

tellings.quote: is a non natural Edge you don't get a 30 mile Edge like that W by Nature

plain: There is a perfectly straight edge 30 miles long on the surface of Mars, too regular to be natural. A man named Joe McMoneagle tells Michels he saw it on photo negatives from Mars mapping work done by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, and he says "you don't get a 30 mile edge like that by nature." If true, it would suggest that something on Mars was built.
